newsitem.title: USA: Orbotech stake cut by Elron.
newsitem.headline: Orbotech stake cut by Elron.

text.p: Elron Electronic Industries Ltd said Thursday it cut its stake in Orbotech Ltd to 1,350,000 ordinary shares or 10.47 percent from 11.88 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Elron said its latest transactions include the sale of 150,000 ordinary shares between January 16 and March 7 in a private placement transaction under rule 144 of the Securities Act.
Orbotech, based in Yavne, Israel, automates the Printed Circuit Board Industry. Elron, based in Haifa, Israel, is a multinational high-technology holding company.
